newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end sharply down on investors' apathy.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end sharply down on investors' apathy.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed sharply lower as investors continued to remain on the sidelines, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) benchmark index lost 135.6 points or 4.63 percent at 2,786.1. Turnoevr was 41.7 million taka. Of 91 traded issues, 87 lost and four gained.

Brokers said buyers were heavy outnumbered by sellers. "The situation has reversed in just two weeks time. People are scared and they don't want to take risk in a falling market," said one broker. Eastern Housing lost 14.66 taka to 278.6 and Monno Fabrics fell 12.86 to 244.42.
